final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.bats, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total as ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM step3) SELECT s3.bats, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.cnt - s4.avg_cnt as difference FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND s3.cnt > s4.avg_cnt
